text:
maya: kicking off deploy for release/1.14.2 — rolling feature flag `llm-route-v2` 0->20% over 10m, canary in us-east-1. please monitor latency/cost.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/1.14.2 -> canary pool (6 instances). health checks enabled. rollback window ends in 20m.

sam (oncall): I'll watch the dashboards. ping me if p95 > 150ms or errors > 0.5% :eyes:

kevin (sre): set temporary holdpoint at 20% if 5xx spike or token-cost +10%. added alert `ff.llm-route-v2.holdpoint`

jorge (eng-release): noted. pinning model to `v2.1-quant` for this rollout to avoid accidental drift. plan B is `v2.0` rollback.

maya: @lina heads-up for product QA — can you run quick smoke set in #dogfooding and report within 8m?

lina (product): on it. running sanity prompts now, will paste failures here.

deploy-bot: Canary health snapshot: cpu 42%, p95 138ms, errors 0.18%, cost/token +3% — nominal.

sam (oncall): looks good so far. suggest continuing to 50% over 15m. @maya ack to ramp?

maya: ack. ramping to 50%.

deploy-bot: Flag `llm-route-v2` now at 50%.

kevin (sre): added circuit-breaker: `tokens_per_sec_threshold = 1.2` to avoid sudden cost spike.

jorge (eng-release): seeing slight quality regression on the \"invoice-summary\" prompt — 2/100 bad outputs. holding at 50% for 10m to investigate.

maya: holding. if regression > 3% for any critical prompt, we'll rollback to `v2.0`. annotate deploy log with `+rollback_reason=\"hallucination_regression\"` if we trigger.

lina (product): confirming failure snippets: pasted short examples below for triage. will add labels (severity:medium).

maya: thanks. if triage shows model tuning issue, we roll back and open an RFC. otherwise continue to 100% after hold.

deploy-bot: Holdpoint triggered at 50% due to manual hold. Canary remains at 50%. Next check in 10m.

sam (oncall): monitoring. ETA to continue or rollback after QA notes.

jorge (eng-release): quick note — I'll prepare release notes with toggle state and model pining details: \"llm-route-v2 pinned to v2.1-quant; rolled to 50% canary; hold for quality review.\" will publish after decision.

maya: agreed. if we rollback, include reproduction steps and the QA snippets in the postmortem.

deploy-bot: Last update: hold active, health nominal, manual review requested.
